EXT.evidence: Excitedly shares news, says they are going to the roof and asks who will go with them, then urges “everyone should come on,” leading a group activity.

AGR.evidence: Invites others to join (“who will go with me,” “everyone should come on”) in a friendly, inclusive way; no signs of conflict or deception.

CON.evidence: Spontaneously decides to go to the roof, but there is no clear evidence of either organized planning or careless neglect.

NEU.evidence: Speaks decisively and confidently (“I’m going to the roof”) without anxiety, taking charge of the situation.

OPN.evidence: Shows eagerness to experience a rare, novel event (escaped parade balloon) and emphasizes its uniqueness, wanting to go see it.
